entities.summary: Ryan Timothy Tannehill III is an American former professional football player who was a quarterback for 12 seasons in the National Football League (NFL) with the Miami Dolphins and Tennessee Titans. He played college football for the Texas A&M Aggies and was selected eighth overall by the Dolphins in the 2012 NFL draft.
